title: Rundeck: In Eclipse Jetty, `TryPathsHandler` and `TryFilesFilter` can be configured to forward requests to template…
description: A security vulnerability in Rundeck affects versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. The issue involves Eclipse Jetty components `TryPathsHandler` and `TryFilesFilter` being configured to forward requests to template URIs that include the request path, potentially leading to unintended request forwarding. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.9. A fix is available in Rundeck version 6.0.1-r11.
